author: The Infographics Show
description:
You can surround a guy with twenty-foot walls of reinforced concrete.
You can watch him with armed snipers, seismic sensors, and biometric scanners.
But none of that matters when a prisoner has a billion dollars and a shovel.
We build modern prisons to be mathematically impossible to escape. But time and time again, the world’s most dangerous men prove the math wrong.
They don't do it by just picking a lock. They do it by breaking the physical and psychological limits of the building itself.
Over the next hour, we’re tearing down the illusion of maximum security.
We're looking at cartel kingpins who dug right under their guards' boots, and men so violently unhinged that other murderers begged to be kept away from them.
And eventually, we have to go back to the rock of Alcatraz.
Because we have to figure out what actually happens when a desperate human brain goes up against an immovable concrete wall.
